Maîtres d'ouvrage de distribution d'eau potable - Département du Loiret

description: Département du Loiret: water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Loiret. Coverage: Département du Loiret. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Maîtres d'ouvrage de production d'eau potable - Département du Loiret; Maîtres d'ouvrage de distribution d'eau potable - Département du Loire; Station d'épuration - Département du Loiret. Formats seen: ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
